label: rare content-specific feature at late original steps / second copy step
explanation: Extremely sparse (0.013% of steps). Location is clear: about 53% of activation mass falls on late original-phase steps (orig_idx 6-8, mostly the last one or two tokens before <DEL>, in long sequences L=8-9), and about 47% on the second copy step (recall_idx 1, where the input is orig(0)). It essentially never fires at t<4, at the <DEL> step, or at recall_idx >= 2. Within those slots it fires on well under 1% of steps, and which ones depends on sequence content I could not capture: enriched for orig(2) = n or l, first token 2/v/i, and in-phase input tokens 2/a/q/v/i/0. The positional predicate gets about 97% recall but precision under 0.1%. Content conjunctions raised precision only to about 6% (F1 < 0.08). Magnitude is fairly uniform (median 0.12, max 0.28), and I found no variable that clearly drives it.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=0 & in_tok=0 (+3.74), in_tok=q (+3.67), orig2=n (+3.66), in_tok=2 (+3.59), orig0=v (+3.58), in_tok=a (+3.44). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-3.19), prev3_tok=- (-2.98), next_out=- (-2.18), phase=2 (-1.90).
